title: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate (MLA-C02)
summary: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate (MLA-C02) is an associate-level certification for practitioners who build and operate on AWS. The exam is organised into 4 content domains: Data Preparation for ML and AI (28%), ML Model and Foundation Model (FM) Development (24%), Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows (24%), Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions (24%). It is delivered as 50 scored questions and 15 unscored, scored against a scaled pass mark of 720 out of 1,000 with no per-domain minimum, so strength in one domain offsets weakness in another. Every task statement in this topic carries a MEDIUM and a HARD exercise batch, so the practice material follows the published outline of the exam rather than a general reading list. The statements here are taken from the exam guide, and the task list is the one AWS publishes: if AWS revises the guide, this topic is revised with it.
objectives: Data Preparation for ML and AI: the guide's domain 1 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
ML Model and Foundation Model (FM) Development: the guide's domain 2 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows: the guide's domain 3 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions: the guide's domain 4 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
